verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Teams provides built-in calling/meetings alongside chat (ms-teams-docs-18), and a community reviewer confirms using built-in voice/video calls for standups (ms-teams-comm-18), supporting in-app calling. However, no evidence specifically documents the UI flow of initiating a call directly from a channel/DM thread, and some community reports cite call/meeting reliability issues (audio/video not working for all participants) that add caveats to quality. Missing for 10: explicit documentation/screenshot of the 'call' button within a channel or DM, and independent confirmation the flow is seamless without friction.
